# Fixture media attribution

`flower-cc0.mp4` is the flower sample distributed by MDN in its `cc0-videos` media
collection:

<https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.mp4>

It is used only as deterministic local test media. Each browser loads its own local copy; the
extension never captures, copies, proxies, or transmits the media.
